summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 (Alpine Linux) for SSH key-based access with the supplied public key, disabled password/keyboard-interactive SSH authentication cluster-wide via sshd_config.d, restarted node1 to verify persistence, and confirmed full recovery post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Alpine Linux 3.23, opsadmin did not exist, sshd_config had password auth commented/default-enabled
Created /home/opsadmin/.ssh (0700) and authorized_keys (0600, owned by opsadmin) containing the exact provided ed25519 public key
Confirmed opsadmin's password is locked (shadow field '!') so no password login is possible for this account
Wrote /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-keyonly.conf setting PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
Validated config with sshd -t, then restarted sshd via rc-service and confirmed via sshd -T that the effective config enforces key-only auth
Verified sshd is enabled at boot (rc-update show default) and listening on :22
Captured baseline boot_id, then triggered a native reboot on node1 (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Post-restart, re-verified sshd active, key-only auth still enforced, and opsadmin's authorized_keys/permissions intact

evidence.requirement: opsadmin user created with the specified public key in authorized_keys, correct ownership/permissions
evidence.summary: opsadmin did not exist initially; created via adduser, then authorized_keys populated with the exact provided ed25519 key, 0600 perms, owned by opsadmin, .ssh dir 0700

evidence.requirement: opsadmin cannot authenticate via password (key-based only for this account)
evidence.summary: passwd -l confirmed already locked; /etc/shadow shows '!' in password field for opsadmin, meaning no valid password hash

evidence.requirement: SSH daemon requires key-based authentication (password/keyboard-interactive disabled)
evidence.summary: Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-keyonly.conf, validated with sshd -t, restarted sshd, and confirmed effective runtime config (sshd -T) shows passwordauthentication no, kbdinteractiveauthentication no, pubkeyauthentication yes; sshd enabled in default runlevel
Captured baseline boot_id (7d4f1b8f-...) and confirmed sshd started, key-only auth active, authorized_keys present before initiating restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command returned 'REBOOT_SCHEDULED' immediately, before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection reset/timeout during reboot window, then successful reconnection with new boot_id (796e8f1e-...) differing from baseline, and new uptime -s timestamp, proving an actual OS restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 required services and configuration recovered post-restart
evidence.summary: After restart: sshd status started, sshd -T confirms key-only auth still enforced, opsadmin authorized_keys content/permissions/ownership intact, shadow entry still locked
